about: scr_check_skill_data, Mav's 1.4.5 fix. Vanilla part (same result before and after the fix): no skill is shared in global.mon_skill, a row merges a second drop of the same troop, every skill alone in a row gives the old value, real rows too. Fix part: a skill held twice in a row adds up, in both rows, including back-row skill 1 (it used = instead of +=).
